reproduction.entry: protobufjs full reflection Root.fromJSON -> Type.toObject with bytes defaults
reproduction.effect: A JSON array element naming a harmless global assignment was executed in 6.11.6. The identical regression leaves the marker unset in 7.6.6.
reproduction.applicationReachability: No current Lenz quote route imports this SDK. The inspected ICS23 generated codec imports protobufjs/minimal and does not accept a schema descriptor. This is a reproduced dependency defect, not a demonstrated application exploit.

retainedFailures: The regression fails before the update (four passes, one code-injection failure), then passes after it.
The first draft used incorrect nonce magic/version constants; source inspection corrected the fixture before the recorded baseline. No SDK code changed.
The first registry read failed with sandbox EACCES; approved access succeeded. The post-update audit exits 1 for remaining advisories.
limits: Override crosses the upstream ICS23 protobuf ^6.8.8 constraint; fixtures cover the recorded interfaces, not every bridge path.
protobufjs 7 no longer bundles the pbjs/pbts CLI. Existing generated codecs are retained; regenerating upstream codecs is not covered.
